tasks.title: Natural terrain mesh prototype and selection

completed_evidence.crate: pc3d_render/src/terrain.rs — culled natural-terrain faces straight from the AUTHORITATIVE final_solid query (P3D-202): neighbors outside the patch are queried directly, so cross-patch culling is exact and seams cannot exist by construction; an 18^3 query cache (patch + 1-cell border) makes every cell+neighbor cost one final_solid call (~7 ms/patch, down from 1.1 s naive)
completed_evidence.hill: SmoothHills scene renders: slope side faces visible (staircase proof, >100 side faces), standable top faces match the collision query's material (probe derived FROM final_solid at the probed cell)

tasks.title: Real terrain streaming, LOD, and seams

completed_evidence.crate: pc3d_render/src/streaming.rs — TerrainStreamer CONSUMES the world's own machinery: stream::interest_patches (disc rings), stream::interest_diff/load-unload planning, stream::BoundedQueue (bounded work, honest counters, P3D-105 teleport law), lod::lod_for (detail bands); terrain.rs gains MeshLod (Full=all faces, Mid=drop bottoms, Far=top-shell only)
completed_evidence.bounded_mesh_queue: at most max_mesh_per_frame CPU mesh jobs and max_uploads_per_frame GPU uploads per frame — GPU test: a far teleport's whole vista (112 patches) completes in 57 frames at cap 2/frame with a 48-job deferral peak held in a caller-side list and re-admitted (never dropped); one live job per coord (pending set), nearest-first priority, stale jobs evicted from the queue when no longer desired
completed_evidence.gpu_upload_budget: per-frame upload cap plus a total GPU-byte budget; over-budget eviction removes the FARTHEST patches first; a patch larger than the whole budget is skipped honestly; GPU test proves gpu_bytes never exceeds the cap and the viewer's full ring survives eviction pressure
completed_evidence.frustum_culling: Gribb-Hartmann planes extracted from the same view-proj matrix the shader uses; per-patch AABB test; unit test proves a patch behind the camera and a patch far off-axis cull while a patch ahead draws; the windowed walk culled 77,875 patch-draws over 351 frames
completed_evidence.no_visible_or_collision_seams: LOD culls only bottom (Mid) and side (Far) faces — top faces render at EVERY level, so the visible shell cannot crack between rings (test: Full and Far meshes have IDENTICAL top-face sets); collision lives only in the Full ring (P3D-105 tier contract) where the mesh is the R3DV-005 collision-aligned full mesh; cross-border agreement is P3D-206's border_agrees
completed_evidence.lod_walk_pngs: --play-stream + make p3d-stream: one windowed run, three waypoints 96 m apart crossing the LOD rings, 351 frames p50 0.91 ms / p95 1.05 ms; 360 patches loaded (101 full / 259 mid), 1053 meshes at cap 3/frame, gpu 24555 KB of 24576 KB budget (eviction active), 30974 draws / 77875 culled; each waypoint capture verified by a query-derived raycast probe (view-center first-hit face color) — all 3 PASS; PNGs human-inspected PASS
completed_evidence.counters: StreamCounters surface queue len/pushed/admitted/rejected, deferred, meshed, uploaded, evicted, upload_bytes, gpu_bytes, loaded per ring, frustum_culled, drawn, per-frame maxima, mesh_us_total — printed by the CLI
completed_evidence.tests: 329/329 pc3d workspace green (+7): frustum plane extraction/culling, ring banding + horizon-free desired set, LOD shrink (cave patch proves Mid drops ceiling undersides; hills prove Far drops slopes), top-shell equality across LOD, teleport bounds + completion, budget invariant + survivors, walk-config full-ring-first
completed_evidence.bugs_found_by_proofs: duplicate queue jobs starved real work (a re-push storm re-meshed loaded patches — fixed with a pending set + pop-time LOD guard; the stuck-job variant was caught by the run's own deferred assertion); coordinate-order queueing loaded the horizon before the viewer's ring (fixed with nearest-first priority); unbounded deferred re-admission churned 318k rejected pushes/frame (fixed with capacity-checked re-admission); a single patch larger than a tiny budget busted the invariant (now skipped and counted)
